kinds.avg: average probability assigned to the average's most probable outcome
kinds.majority: mean probability of the strict-majority outcome over all members (dissenters included); votes recorded
kinds.single: member probability of its most probable outcome
kinds.stack: probability from the cohort's learned stacker (refit on the two earlier seasons)
kinds.stack_pool: probability from the pool stacker fitted on earlier out-of-sample forecasts (frozen weights)
kinds.unanimous: minimum probability assigned by the members to the agreed outcome (all present, all agree)
